scope: Diagnostic evidence, correctness issue and test suggestions. No claim of original-workload throughput gain or research novelty.
readiness_contract: During real loading, the observed LOAD_START plus declared load duration supplies a lawful readiness estimate; remaining node service follows that estimate. Future contention remains conditional.
After actual source admission or physical intermediate arrival, use the actual committed local service end. Do not restart the full service duration at forecast capture.
After service completion while waiting for arbitration or receiving capacity, remaining node service is zero; earliest dispatch is now, conditional on resources.
Before source admission, LOAD_COMPLETE alone does not prove service has started. Source queue contention can delay actual admission.
A per-leg, per-node observed service-ready field must be reset on stage changes and included in protocol checkpoint integrity. Source-only BagState.admitted_time cannot represent later nodes.
Do not infer service readiness by inspecting the future event heap, unannounced faults, unarrived business tape, or remote private reservations.
event_notification_tests: Paired worlds with identical owner-local events and delivered packets but different remote private events produce identical owner notification records, sequence numbers and returned wake-up times before a legitimate causal influence.
Future local jobs and future faults do not appear or alter notification sequence before arrival or lawful advertisement.
A zero-duration LOAD_START and LOAD_COMPLETE at one timestamp cannot expose an interruptible loading state; the returned notification accompanies the fully processed timestamp state.

Whole-timestamp processing includes all same-time events and newly scheduled same-time events. A budget-exhausted partial timestamp may not produce a completed-boundary notification or permit controller mutation.
Local service durations below, equal to and above command delay retain unchanged physical priorities; exact ties are not assumed failures.
Owner outage, dropped ACK, stale forecast withdrawal, restart and native-plus-JSON continuation preserve notifications and the client outbox without accessing server truth.
An empty owner notification queue must not expose the next private global event time as the controller's wake time.
r2_limit: A next-hop soft service window helps avoid conditional local contention. It does not announce final unloading/hold completion, create an empty tray, permit remote export, certify future receiving capacity, or prove normal-service protection. Existing release_forecasts uses a lawful local tray and public job contract with capacity-relaxed timing; all actual transfers remain owner-validated.
acceptance_limit: Measure whether the delivered window remains temporally useful and matches actual service timing. ACK delivered alone is not predictive value: in the service=2 case the peer receives at 2.5 after real edge entry at 2 while the old estimate incorrectly says 4.
